algorithm.Title: Ankle Pain - Male (Adult)
algorithm.ContentSet: IST Open-Source Guideline Content | Adult | Male
Definition: UAT-only adult and pediatric non-traumatic ankle-pain pathway screening for joint infection, systemic illness, inability to bear weight and neurovascular compromise before in-person assessment.
FirstAid: Call Qatar emergency services on 999 for a hot swollen joint with systemic illness, severe pain, inability to bear weight, deformity, a cold/pale/blue/numb foot, or rapid deterioration. Do not allow self-driving or force movement. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.

questions.Question: Did this problem begin with a motor vehicle crash or as part of a multi-system crash injury?
questions.Information: A motor vehicle crash or multi-system crash injury belongs in the Motor Vehicle Accident pathway.

questions.Question: Is ankle pain severe with inability to bear weight, neurovascular change, or a hot swollen joint plus marked systemic illness, confusion, breathing change, collapse or rapid deterioration?
questions.Information: Severe functional loss, neurovascular compromise, or marked systemic deterioration requires emergency assessment through the Qatar pathway.

questions.Question: With no emergency feature, is there any persistent or unexplained ankle pain, hot swelling, functional limitation, child joint concern or higher-risk context?
questions.Information: This UAT pathway requires in-person assessment and does not authorize remote diagnosis, fixed medication advice or pediatric self-care.

advice.Title: Qatar emergency ankle-joint response
Content: Call Qatar emergency services on 999 for a hot swollen joint with systemic illness, severe pain, inability to bear weight, deformity, a cold/pale/blue/numb foot, or rapid deterioration. Do not allow self-driving or force movement. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.
Call Back If: increasing swelling or redness; fever or systemic illness; cannot bear weight.

advice.Title: In-person ankle assessment
Content: Arrange in-person assessment through an approved Qatar adult or pediatric pathway. Protect the joint and use wrapped cold briefly if comfortable. Do not provide fixed-dose analgesia until age, weight, pregnancy, allergies, kidney/liver disease and interactions are checked under an approved pathway.
Call Back If: pain or swelling worsens; redness, fever or inability to bear weight.

references: NHS.UK, "Joint pain" (non-injury pain guidance), https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/joint-pain/ (page last reviewed 26 February 2026) - applied to non-traumatic ankle pain
